richiami.difetto: Due to a manufacturing defect there may be a dimensional deviation in the affected control  arms which can cause damage to the sub-frame and lead to steering problems.
richiami.rimedio: Affected control arms will be replaced.
richiami.titolo: Voluntary Recall: MEYLE no. 416 050 0005 + 416 050 0005/S suitable for  Porsche 911 Boxster and Cayman
